source.author: Sig Lonegren / Mid-Atlantic Geomancy

source.locator: The Search Position;Yes and No;Yes but and No but;Asking questions through dowsing;Dowsing blind
source.finding: Website uses initial to-and-fro search motion,individual yes/no signals or suggested clockwise/anticlockwise fallback,partial signals and misleading-question response. Wording matters;blind known-answer practice suggested. Source-defined conventions and metaphysical claims require distinct labels;neither universal direction mapping nor guaranteed factual calibration follows.
source.rights_note: Original short factual paraphrases only;no website prose,photo,downloaded diagram or full exercise corpus copied. Print procedure equivalence unverified.

rules.statement: The source starts with to-and-fro motion as a search state.
Individual signals are permitted; suggested circular signals are a fallback,not universal.
Incomplete responses call for clarification rather than a complete answer.
A separate misleading-question signal prompts reconsideration.

rules.locator: Asking questions through dowsing - The Eight Step Method,step5
rules.statement: Questions should admit a clear binary response;ambiguous wording matters.
The source suggests known-answer checking;this does not establish predictive validity.

signals.clockwise: Reported circular motion clockwise from observer viewpoint
signals.counterclockwise: Reported circular motion counterclockwise from observer viewpoint
signals.vertical: Reported to-and-fro motion toward/away from body;calibration or search context required
signals.searching: User explicitly classifies motion as search/neutral
signals.partial: Incomplete movement without a specified full category

calibration.format: Explicit list of signal/response pairs;no implicit clockwise=yes
calibration.complete: At least one distinct yes signal and no signal required for any resolved session
calibration.conflicts: Duplicate or contradictory entries rejected;no silent repair
calibration.reserved: Searching,still,partial,conflicting,unknown remain unresolved and cannot be remapped
calibration.source_boundary: Individual mappings are source-permitted;fixed vocabulary,validation and conservative aggregation are application conventions

observations.unknown_signal: Retain supplied plain-text category as unrecognized;never infer yes/no
observations.aggregation: Unanimous full resolved responses only;any partial,missing,neutral,unknown or disagreement makes session unresolved. No voting or confidence estimate.
observations.source_boundary: Repetition and conservative aggregation are editorial application policy,not a source-verified historical ritual

simulation.framing: ASCII FuturePendulum NUL v1 NUL symbolic-response NUL + uint32be UTF8 seed length + strict UTF8 seed + uint64be block counter starting0
simulation.words: SHA256 digest split into8 uint32be words;existing Stream.word/Stream.below rejection primitive unchanged
simulation.weight_authority: Editorial digital allocation only;not historical frequencies or probability that an answer is true

question: Optional plain UTF8 context;not analyzed for truth and never included in RNG framing
scope: Manual reported observations and separately seeded symbolic categories;no print Kit chart/rate implementation,actual motion detection or truth validation
rights: Only original factual paraphrases and application conventions. No website prose/photo,Kit charts,Lethbridge rate table,article corpus or artwork copied.
limits: Search state depends on declared calibration/context;vertical alone is not a universal yes or search signal
Calibration maps symbols;it does not validate factual answers
Digital results are categories,not generated movement or physical ideomotor simulation
No factual assurance,hidden events,health/financial advice,personality/emotional inference or confidence scores
